hints.title: Independent Row Products
hints.text: Every device in a row connects to every device in the next row containing at least one device.

hints.title: Zero-Device Row Bypass
hints.text: Rows with zero security devices do not block or generate laser beams.

hints.title: Cumulative Beam Sum
hints.text: Multiply the device count of the previous non-empty row by the current row count and add to the total.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(M * N) single pass device counting
complexity.notes: Beams between adjacent non-empty rows equal the product of their device counts.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating beams between individual device pairs takes quadratic O((M*N)^2) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Product of row device sums counts all intersecting beams in constant space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should multiply consecutive non-empty row device counts.
